doc.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016

title: Miles Davis finding the right players
summary: Miles stayed himself and chose the right young players; Thomas tells the story of Miles listening to Herbie, Tony, Ron and Wayne.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: that’s one thing he was a master at. Miles was the master at finding the right guys. He didn’t change. You know? Miles never really changed as far as his playing. He just got the right cats under him because he knew what sound he was going for and he was like, okay, these young guys know the vibe boom-boom-boom-boom we’ll try the young vibe and then put my thing on top of it. And that was something.
Did you hear the story about when Miles first got Herbie, Tony, Ron and Wayne together?

Yeah right. I think this is the one where they first went to his house. And he was in another room. And they didn’t know that he was listening to them from the other room. But he was just checking them out.
Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. That makes sense. Yeah. That totally makes sense.
Yeah. Like a master of masters, teacher of teachers. I mean so many leaders came from Miles.
